title: Sidebar menu toggle aria-label is hardcoded English
product: @vc-shell/framework / Marketplace Vendor Portal (separate product, not the storefront)
linked_fix_pr_note: The ticket had NO comments at all — no dev note, no PR reference. The fix was located from main's history via the VCST-5668 mention in the commit body.
environment: vc-shell main @ 324cd9b09 (= v2.5.0) + deployed vcmp-dev vendor-portal; console banner reported framework v2.5.0 · 2026-08-19T10:23:58Z · 2964ccbe3
agent_used: qa-backend-expert (playwright-edge) for the live pass; unit probes and the sweep run inline
design_choice_note: The ticket offered two options — reuse VC_BLADE.CLOSE_MENU, or add a dedicated pair under VC_APP. The dev took the second, the better of the two: a blade-scoped key reads wrong on an app-level control.

unit.red: 2 failed | 208 passed (210) with SidebarHeader.vue reverted, its 2 added tests unchanged
unit.test_design_note: the test stubs $t to return the key, so a raw English string is exactly what fails — it cannot pass by accident and it detects precisely this defect

deploy_gate.bundle: served vc-shell-framework22260.js contains 'Menü öffnen' x1, 'Menü schließen' x2, 'Open menu' x1, 'Close menu' x2 — the asymmetry corroborates the key topology exactly (CLOSE_MENU already existed under VC_BLADE and was added under VC_APP; OPEN_MENU is new), matching the ticket's own note that no OPEN_MENU key existed

detail.localized_both_states_en_and_de: PARTIAL — en confirmed live (Open menu / Close menu, no raw keys, a11y tree corroborated, clean toggle); de NOT exercisable, see notes[0]
detail.check_locales_passes: PASS — exit 0, 'All localizations are in sync with en.json!'
detail.no_hardcoded_aria_label_in_sidebarheader: PASS — both labels in the file are $t(...) calls (:38 notifications, :76 the burger)

check1_english_both_states.note: no raw key in either state; accessibility tree read as button "Open menu"; second click returned it cleanly

check2_german.verdict: BLOCKED — explicitly NOT counted as a pass
check2_german.note: A locale switcher exists (user menu -> Language) and was opened as a real user: exactly ONE option, 'English', marked active. localStorage VC_LANGUAGE_SETTINGS=en. The framework ships the de strings but the selectable-locale list is registered by the vendor-portal APP, not the framework, and vcmp-dev registers English only. No legitimate user-facing route to de exists; forcing it via storage/app state was deliberately not done because it would prove nothing about the shipped switcher.

check3_bell_control.note: notification bell reads 'Notifications' — resolved, not a key. Since the burger resolves too, i18n works generally AND specifically here; no burger-specific failure.

live_checks.render_conditions: desktop layout only, sidebar expanded (pinned or hovered), not embedded — .sidebar-header__toolbar is v-if="expanded && !isMobile" and the burger also needs showBurger. At 600x900 the header switches to the mobile variant and neither burger nor bell exists in the DOM.
live_checks.console: no vue-i18n missing-key or fallback warnings at any point

notes: The German half of AC1 is unverifiable on this deployment: the Vendor Portal registers English as its only selectable locale. Nothing suggests de would fail (same $t() call, keys present in de.json, check:locales green) but it is unproven at runtime and not counted as passed. Closing it needs a deployed env whose app registers de, or a Storybook/framework-level check where the framework's own locale set is reachable.

Beyond this ticket: if no deployed environment offers a second locale, EVERY localization AC in this product is unverifiable at runtime and the shipped German translations are effectively untested. A process question for the team, not a defect in this fix.

The sweep the ticket invited shows this was NOT the last hardcoded aria-label — 13 further code sites in 12 components remain. Four are the identical shape to the defect just fixed (a ternary of two English strings): vc-status-icon, vc-editor, DataTableCellRenderer, TableGroupRow.

METHOD CAVEAT: my first detector came back clean and I nearly reported 'this was the last one'. Validating it against the pre-fix tree showed it failed to catch the very defect this ticket describes — the original is a TERNARY of quoted literals, which a ':aria-label="'' pattern cannot match. The rewritten detector scores 16 pre-fix -> 15 post-fix, delta exactly SidebarHeader.vue. Only with that validation is an empty result meaningful.

sweep.scope: framework/ui + framework/shell, 229 .vue files, 136 aria-label bindings, excluding *.test.* / *.stories.*
list: vc-status-icon.vue:5 — 'Active'/'Inactive'  [same shape as the fixed defect]

SchedulerMonthView.vue:54 — leftover 'p' is a date-format token; the template interpolates data only

coverage_limits: The collapsed-sidebar-hover render variant is source-derived only — not exercised live, to avoid persisting a sidebar-state change. The mobile-width negative case WAS verified live.
